name: Virtual list lens dial turns Misread into Read correctly and back

planSteps.description: Stay on the page that is already open at the start URL and do not navigate to any other address: the chart is on that page. Wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Click the 'About' button in the top bar to open the About panel
In the About panel's lens machine, verify the 'List positions and a jump field' dial shows Off and its reading line says 'Misread'
Click the 'List positions and a jump field' lens dial
Verify the dial's reading line now says 'Misread → Read correctly' and the reading summary in the About panel begins 'With 1 lens on.'
Click the 'List positions and a jump field' lens dial again
Verify the dial's reading line says 'Misread' again and the reading summary no longer mentions a lens
